content.text: I’ve confirmed an important boundary in the existing repository: its native-build matrix is consumer-configured, not a universal build command. I’m preserving that distinction in the workflow instead of hard-coding a fictitious build; the release pipeline will transport and attest declared outputs, while the graph/CLI contract remains the authority for whether any binary slots exist.

+name: Durable release
+
+on:
+  push:
+    branches: [main]
+  workflow_dispatch:
+
+# No job inherits a write-capable token. The only write boundary is `execute`.
+permissions: {}
+
+concurrency:
+  group: durable-release-${{ github.ref }}
+  cancel-in-progress: false
+
+jobs:
+  verify:
+    name: Verify release candidate
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    permissions:
+      contents: read
+    steps:
+      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2
+        with:
+          fetch-depth: 0
+          persist-credentials: false
+      - uses: ./.github/actions/setup-callisto
+        with:
+          source: local
+      - uses: extractions/setup-just@dd310ad5a97d8e7b41793f8ef055398d51ad4de6 # v2
+      - run: just fmt-check
+      - run: just lint
+      - run: just test
+      - run: just wasm-check
+      - name: Reject mutable GitHub Actions references
+        run: .github/tests/verify-action-pins.sh
+
+  version-pr:
+    name: Create or update the Callisto release PR
+    needs: verify
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    permissions:
+      contents: write
+      pull-requests: write
+    outputs:
+      has_pending_changesets: ${{ steps.status.outputs.has_pending_changesets }}
+    steps:
+      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2
+        with:
+          fetch-depth: 0
+      - uses: ./.github/actions/setup-callisto
+        with:
+          source: local
+      - name: Inspect pending changesets
+        id: status
+        shell: bash
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          set +e
+          callisto status --check
+          status=$?
+          set -e
+          case "$status" in
+            1) echo 'has_pending_changesets=true' >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT" ;;
+            2) echo 'has_pending_changesets=false' >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT" ;;
+            *) echo "::error::callisto status --check exited $status"; exit 1 ;;
+          esac
+      - name: Compose, version, and open the release PR
+        if: steps.status.outputs.has_pending_changesets == 'true'
+        shell: bash
+        env:
+          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          branch='callisto/version-packages'
+          label='callisto: release'
+          title='chore(release): version packages'
+          body=$(gh pr list --head "$branch" --json body --jq '.[0].body // empty')
+          if [[ -n "$body" ]]; then
+            body=$(printf '%s' "$body" | callisto compose-pr-body --existing-body - --label "$label" --branch main --format text)
+          else
+            body=$(callisto compose-pr-body --label "$label" --branch main --format text)
+          fi
+          # `callisto version` is the sole operation that edits manifests,
+          # changelogs, and removes exactly the changesets it consumed.
+          callisto version
+          if [[ -z $(git status --porcelain) ]]; then
+            echo '::error::pending changesets produced no release-PR delta'
+            exit 1
+          fi
+          git config user.name 'github-actions[bot]'
+          git config user.email '41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com'
+          git switch -C "$branch"
+          git add -A
+          git commit -m "$title"
+          git push --force-with-lease origin "$branch"
+          gh label create "$label" --color 0e8a16 --description 'Callisto release packages' 2>/dev/null || true
+          pr=$(gh pr list --head "$branch" --json number --jq '.[0].number // empty')
+          if [[ -n "$pr" ]]; then
+            gh pr edit "$pr" --title "$title" --body "$body" --add-label "$label"
+          else
+            gh pr create --head "$branch" --base main --title "$title" --body "$body" --label "$label"
+          fi
+
+  release-candidate:
+    name: Identify a merged Callisto release PR
+    needs: [verify, version-pr]
+    if: needs.version-pr.outputs.has_pending_changesets == 'false'
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    permissions:
+      contents: read
+      pull-requests: read
+    outputs:
+      is_release_pr: ${{ steps.candidate.outputs.is_release_pr }}
+    steps:
+      - id: candidate
+        shell: bash
+        env:
+          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          # This is only a scheduling hint. `release plan` independently
+          # verifies the parent-to-merge delta; PR metadata is never authority.
+          prs=$(gh api --paginate "/repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/commits/${GITHUB_SHA}/pulls" --jq '[.[] | select(.merged_at != null and .base.ref == "main" and .head.ref == "callisto/version-packages")] | length')
+          if [[ "$prs" == '1' ]]; then
+            echo 'is_release_pr=true' >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
+          else
+            echo 'is_release_pr=false' >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
+          fi
+
+  plan:
+    name: Derive ephemeral release intent from merge commit
+    needs: release-candidate
+    if: needs.release-candidate.outputs.is_release_pr == 'true'
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    permissions:
+      contents: read
+    steps:
+      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2
+        with:
+          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
+          fetch-depth: 0
+          persist-credentials: false
+      - uses: ./.github/actions/setup-callisto
+        with:
+          source: local
+      - name: Derive and hash the intent
+        shell: bash
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          callisto release plan --merged-release-commit --out release-intent.json
+          shasum -a 256 release-intent.json > release-intent.json.sha256
+      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4.6.2
+        with:
+          name: callisto-release-intent-${{ github.run_id }}
+          path: |
+            release-intent.json
+            release-intent.json.sha256
+          if-no-files-found: error
+          retention-days: 1
+
+  build:
+    name: Build and attest intent-bound artifacts
+    needs: plan
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    permissions:
+      contents: read
+      attestations: write
+      id-token: write
+    steps:
+      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2
+        with:
+          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
+          fetch-depth: 0
+          persist-credentials: false
+      - uses: ./.github/actions/setup-callisto
+        with:
+          source: local
+      - uses: extractions/setup-just@dd310ad5a97d8e7b41793f8ef055398d51ad4de6 # v2
+      - uses: actions/download-artifact@d3f86a106a0bac45b974a628896c90dbdf5c8093 # v4.3.0
+        with:
+          name: callisto-release-intent-${{ github.run_id }}
+          path: .release-handoff
+      - name: Verify handoff and build source packages
+        shell: bash
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          (cd .release-handoff && shasum -a 256 -c release-intent.json.sha256)
+          callisto release inspect --input .release-handoff/release-intent.json
+          # Native artifact production is repository-configured. A future
+          # declared binary slot must produce `release-artifacts/manifest.json`
+          # and the exact files named by the intent; execute refuses slots
+          # without that manifest and independently checks their attestations.
+          just build
+      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4.6.2
+        with:
+          name: callisto-release-build-${{ github.run_id }}
+          path: .release-handoff
+          if-no-files-found: error
+          retention-days: 1
+
+  environment-policy:
+    name: Verify release Environment protection
+    needs: build
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    permissions:
+      actions: read
+    steps:
+      - name: Require reviewers on the release Environment
+        shell: bash
+        env:
+          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}

+          set -euo pipefail

+          if [[ "$reviewers" == 0 ]]; then
+            echo '::error::GitHub Environment release has no required-reviewers protection rule'
+            exit 1
+          fi
+

+    name: Execute approved release
+    needs: environment-policy
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    environment: release
+    permissions:
+      contents: write
+      attestations: read
+      id-token: write
+    steps:
+      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2
+        with:
+          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
+          fetch-depth: 0
+          persist-credentials: false
+      - uses: ./.github/actions/setup-callisto
+        with:
+          source: local
+      - uses: actions/download-artifact@d3f86a106a0bac45b974a628896c90dbdf5c8093 # v4.3.0
+        with:
+          name: callisto-release-intent-${{ github.run_id }}
+          path: .release-intent
+      - uses: actions/download-artifact@d3f86a106a0bac45b974a628896c90dbdf5c8093 # v4.3.0

+          name: callisto-release-build-${{ github.run_id }}
+          path: .release-build

+PR versions manifests and changelogs and removes only the changesets it consumed. Nothing is

- `7c4c92c` — SHA-pinned external actions, pin-policy check, local-only setup mode, least-privilege release topology.
- `ce35ea7` — durable release and Environment-gate documentation.
- `adbb375` — binds planning to GitHub-verified managed release merges; correct `--from-release-commit` invocation.

The legacy composite action remains because native build parity is not yet portable/configured in the new path. I also flagged the artifact verifier’s missing `--signer-digest` binding and the real-admin prerequisite for CODEOWNERS/branch protection.
